$comment: Generated by tools/token-contexts.mjs: aliases that read a token the motion modifier overrides, declared again in each motion context so they follow a subtree's context. Never edit by hand.

fill-move.$description: How long the fill takes to reach a new percentage (Q65 C26, the move role, linear); 0 under reduced motion: it snaps to each update (echoed for motion contexts)

float.$description: MP21: how far a floating part rises; 0 with reduced motion (echoed for motion contexts)

fade.$description: The finished picture fading in where the wait was (Q65 C14: the change role) (echoed for motion contexts)

reveal-reduced-duration.$description: LR26: with reduced motion a reveal isn't drawn; the pair crossfades in over the resting tone for this long. A brand sets it with applySettings (echoed for motion contexts)

fade.$description: The thumb fading in and out in the shown-on-scroll mode; 0 under reduced motion (echoed for motion contexts)

page-in.$description: Page change: the new page, already at the top, fades in over this time; out plus in stays within 200 ms; 0 under reduced motion (echoed for motion contexts)

page-out.$description: Page change: the old page fades out completely in this time before anything else happens; 0 under reduced motion (echoed for motion contexts)
